get_2d_sincos_pos_embed: generate 2D sine-cosine position embeddings for a given grid size and embedding dimension
get_1d_sincos_pos_embed_from_grid: compute 1D sine-cosine position embeddings from a list of positions
interpolate_pos_embed: interpolate checkpoint position embeddings to match a new model's patch size using bicubic interpolation
